key_insight: A two-stage "synthesize-and-reground" pipeline generates large-scale, faithful, and realistic scientific multimodal document reasoning data by synthesizing claim-centric QA on focused segments and programmatically re-embedding them into full-document tasks.
problem_solved: Addresses the core trade-off in building scientific multimodal document reasoning datasets — achieving scale without sacrificing faithfulness and real-world document realism for foundation model training and evaluation.
method: Claim-Centric QA Synthesis: produce faithful, isolated QA pairs and stepwise reasoning anchored to focused document segments (figures, paragraphs, tables).
Document-Scale Regrounding: programmatically re-embed synthesized QA into full-document contexts, adding layout, distractors, and multimodal alignment to preserve realism.
End-to-end pipeline design that scales synthetic data while maintaining provenance and evaluation-ready fidelity.
impact: Enables practitioners to create and benchmark large, realistic multimodal scientific datasets that improve model generalization and more reliable evaluation of document reasoning capabilities.
